items.title: Cron preview text is hand-rolled, not cronstrue-backed (N4 deviation, waived)
acceptance: GIVEN a cron expression entered through the new CronField's structured editor
WHEN the human-readable preview text (shared/ui/cron/describe.ts) is compared against the baseline's cronstrue-generated text for the same expression
THEN wording differs cosmetically from the baseline for most expressions (for example connector phrasing around weekday/month restrictions)

AND an explicit minute-list crossed with an hour-list (for example "0 8,18 * * *") renders as clock times ("At 08:00 and 18:00"), matching the baseline's clock-time formatting rather than raw field syntax
AND this is a deliberate N4 deviation, waived because spec section 2.3 mandates hand-rolling this unit rather than adding cronstrue as a new dependency

waiver.reason: Hand-rolled preview text (describe.ts) was chosen over adding cronstrue as a new dependency, per spec section 2.3's own "prefer writing it yourself" mandate for unit S7 (no new cron-shaped dependency). This produces permanent cosmetic wording differences from the baseline's cronstrue output. It also originally produced a non-cosmetic regression for explicit multi-value time-list expressions (for example "0 8,18 * * *" rendering raw field syntax, "At minute 0 of hour 8,18", instead of clock-time formatting) — that regression was fixed in the same change that adds this waiver (describe.ts now cross-products minute-list x hour-list into clock times), so only the cosmetic wording deviation remains outstanding.
waiver.replacesBehaviour: cronstrue.toString(expression, { use24HourTimeFormat: true }) from indexSchedule.helpers.js:147, rendered in IndexScheduleModal.jsx's cron-explanation Typography and reused (via the same validator) by PipelineScheduleModal.jsx
